description: This file defines the LeadsViewEdit class, which extends ViewEdit, and is responsible for handling the edit view of the Leads module within the SuiteCRM project. It sets properties to allow use as a subpanel and to use a module QuickCreate template.

classes.name: LeadsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit responsible for rendering and handling the edit view for leads, with specific properties enabling subpanel use and QuickCreate template.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LeadsViewEdit instance, calling the parent constructor and setting properties for subpanel use and QuickCreate template.
